newsitem.title: PANAMA: Panama postpones Rio Hato tourist development sale.
newsitem.headline: Panama postpones Rio Hato tourist development sale.

text.p: Panama's national tourism Institute (IPAT) postponed on Wednesday the sale of a tourism concession at the old military base in Rio Hato after only one bidder showed at auction, IPAT said.

IPAT director Pedro Campagnani said the new sale date had been set for November 5 after only the Mexican consortium International Realty Group Inc and Cluster S.A. had bid. Other prequalified bidders included Panama's Tropical Resort International Inc and Spain's Zither Holding Ltd.

The concession to build and run four 500-room beach hotels at the old U.S. military base in Rio Hato, 115 kilometres from the capital, will run for 40 years and is excepted to provide 3,150 jobs, Campagnani added.
